content:
maya-docs: Quick heads-up: I noticed /v1/queries API reference shows the request as raw array in examples (curl + js). Runtime expects { "queries": [...] } object. Filing a docs PR now to avoid customer confusion.

sasha-eng: Can you paste the broken curl example here? I need to update the request parsing tests to match.

maya-docs: Broken example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/queries \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '[
    {"text":"hello"},
    {"text":"world"}
  ]'
```

maya-docs: Fixed example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/queries \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries":[{"text":"hello"},{"text":"world"}]}'
```

mike-sdk: Thx — Ruby SDK snippet also uses array. I'll open a quick PR to change sample to `client.queries.create(queries: [...])` and add note about compat. Anyone object?

laura-product: We should add a migration note in the api-changes doc and a short blurb in the breaking-changes section of the release notes. Customers may have relied on array behaviour.

jake-support: Support ticket #4521 reported "400 malformed request body" — linking it here so we can update response guidance: suggest showing changed error and example how to transform array -> object.

maya-docs: Added PR 4123 to fix examples + migration guide. Also added a small JS helper snippet to transform legacy arrays. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123

docs-bot: PR 4123 merged by laura-product into main :tada:

sasha-eng: Confirmed runtime accepts both shapes now via compatibility shim, but we'll deprecate array in 2 months. I'll add a flag in tests to ensure shim remains for that window.
